documents.title: Japandi Interior Design Style
documents.content: Japandi: A hybrid aesthetic blending Scandinavian functional simplicity and warm, serene Japanese wabi-sabi minimalism.. Key Elements: Clean lines, Low-profile furniture, Natural unvarnished woods, Muted earth tones, Textured ceramics, Paper lanterns, Biophilic minimalism. Materials: Light white oak, Walnut, Bamboo, Linen, Wabi-sabi ceramic, Jute, Paper cord. Signature Pieces: Low-platform sofa, Paper lantern pendant light, Slatted oak sideboard, Minimalist ceramic vase, Low round ash coffee table.

documents.title: Scandinavian Interior Design Style
documents.content: Scandinavian: Nordic interior design emphasizing hygge coziness, luminous light maximization, clean functionality, and organic textures.. Key Elements: Bright airy spaces, Light wood tones, Plush wool and shearling throws, Functional storage, Simple geometric silhouettes. Materials: Bleached pine, Birch, Ash, Wool, Boucle, Cotton canvas, Matte ceramic. Signature Pieces: Tapered leg sofa in oat grey, Nesting round coffee tables, Wishbone dining chairs, Arched brass floor lamp, High-pile wool Moroccan-style rug.

signaturePieces: Tapered leg sofa in oat grey

documents.title: Mid-Century Modern Interior Design Style
documents.content: Mid-Century Modern: Iconic 1950s-1960s aesthetic defined by sleek architectural curves, organic shapes, rich warm woods, and statement lighting.. Key Elements: Tapered peg legs, Walnut wood tones, Organic sculptural curves, Statement brass sputnik lighting, Bold geometric accents. Materials: American walnut, Teak, Brass, Molded plywood, Top-grain leather, Velvet. Signature Pieces: Tufted walnut-frame leather sofa, Eames-style lounge chair, Kidney-shaped coffee table, Brass multi-arm chandelier, Geometric flat-weave wool rug.

documents.title: Modern Farmhouse Interior Design Style
documents.content: Modern Farmhouse: A comfortable blend of rustic countryside warmth, reclaimed timbers, and crisp contemporary contrast.. Key Elements: Shiplap accents, Black iron hardware, Reclaimed wood surfaces, Neutral slipcovered seating, Woven basket storage. Materials: Distressed oak, Matte black steel, Washed linen, Galvanized metal, Jute, Ceramic subway tile. Signature Pieces: Slipcovered Belgian linen sofa, Trestle reclaimed wood dining table, Matte black lantern pendant, Jute area rug, Sliding barn-door media console.

documents.title: Industrial Interior Design Style
documents.content: Industrial: Urban loft aesthetic showcasing raw architectural bones, exposed brick, distressed metals, and utilitarian character.. Key Elements: Exposed brick and concrete, Piping and ductwork, Dark metal framing, Aged vintage leather, Edison bulb fixtures. Materials: Distressed leather, Reclaimed iron, Cast iron, Concrete, Reclaimed pine, Wire glass. Signature Pieces: Cognac leather Chesterfield sofa, Factory cart iron coffee table, Steel frame bookcase, Pulley pendant light, Distressed vintage overdyed rug.

documents.title: Bohemian (Boho Modern) Interior Design Style
documents.content: Bohemian (Boho Modern): Free-spirited, layered interior filled with lush indoor greenery, globally inspired textiles, rattan, and artisanal craft.. Key Elements: Layered textiles, Macrame and fringe, Abundant houseplants, Rattan and cane furniture, Warm terracotta tones. Materials: Rattan, Wicker, Cane, Jute, Terracotta, Vintage kilim, Bamboo. Signature Pieces: Rattan peacock accent chair, Layered kilim rugs, Macrame plant hangers, Live-edge wood coffee table, Moroccan leather poufs.

documents.title: Minimalist Interior Design Style
documents.content: Minimalist: Extreme intentionality, uncluttered sightlines, high-quality materiality, and subtle textural contrast.. Key Elements: Zero clutter, Concealed storage, Monochromatic palettes, Sculptural focal points, Maximum negative space. Materials: Travertine, Polished microcement, Matte lacquered MDF, Boucle, Brushed stainless steel. Signature Pieces: Floating media unit, Travertine stone plinth coffee table, Minimalist flush-mount linear LED, Seamless tailored sectional, Sculptural off-white ceramic urn.

documents.title: Coastal Modern Interior Design Style
documents.content: Coastal Modern: Breezy, sun-drenched style drawing inspiration from coastal shorelines with natural woven fibers, soft blues, and crisp linens.. Key Elements: Abundant natural light, Airy white curtains, Seagrass and abaca textures, Weathered driftwood tones, Soft ocean hues. Materials: Bleached oak, Linen, Seagrass, Capiz shell, Rope, Ceramic. Signature Pieces: Slipcovered off-white sectional, Woven abaca coffee table, Beaded coastal chandelier, Driftwood console table, Blue-striped linen throw pillows.

documents.title: 60-30-10 Proportional Color Harmony
documents.content: Color Rule: 60-30-10 Proportional Color Harmony. Category: color_theory. Guideline: Divide room colors into 60% dominant base (walls, large rugs, primary sofa), 30% secondary supporting color (accent chairs, curtains, secondary furniture), and 10% accent color (cushions, artwork, decorative ceramics, hardware).

documents.title: Warm vs Cool Undertone Cohesion
documents.content: Color Rule: Warm vs Cool Undertone Cohesion. Category: color_harmony. Guideline: Avoid clashing undertones by pairing warm whites (cream, ivory, alabaster) with warm woods (oak, walnut, brass) or cool whites (pure white, crisp grey) with cool metals (chrome, black steel, slate).

documents.title: Biophilic Natural Anchor
documents.content: Color Rule: Biophilic Natural Anchor. Category: color_harmony. Guideline: Introducing muted botanical greens (sage, eucalyptus, forest) anchors neutral interiors and reduces visual fatigue while harmonizing with light wood tones.

documents.title: Rug Sizing & Seating Anchor
documents.content: Spatial Rule: Rug Sizing & Seating Anchor. Room Type: living_room. Category: living_room. Rule: In living rooms, the area rug should be large enough that at least the front two legs of all main seating pieces (sofas and armchairs) sit firmly on the rug. Standard sizes: 8x10 ft or 9x12 ft. Never float a tiny 'postage stamp' rug in the middle.

documents.title: Sofa to Coffee Table Ergonomics
documents.content: Spatial Rule: Sofa to Coffee Table Ergonomics. Room Type: living_room. Category: living_room. Rule: Maintain 14 to 18 inches (35 to 45 cm) of clearance between the front edge of the sofa and the coffee table. This provides comfortable legroom while keeping drinks and books within easy arm's reach.

documents.title: Coffee Table Height Ratio
documents.content: Spatial Rule: Coffee Table Height Ratio. Room Type: living_room. Category: living_room. Rule: The top of the coffee table should be 1 to 2 inches lower than the seat cushion height of the adjacent sofa or sectional, usually between 16 to 18 inches high.

documents.title: Three-Tier Lighting Strategy
documents.content: Spatial Rule: Three-Tier Lighting Strategy. Room Type: all. Category: lighting. Rule: Every well-designed room must include 3 distinct layers of light: 1. Ambient lighting (central flush mount, chandelier, or cove lighting for general brightness); 2. Task lighting (desk lamps, floor reading lamps beside armchairs, bedside sconces); 3. Accent lighting (picture lights over art, LED strip backlighting on shelving, uplights).

documents.title: Wall Art Eye-Level Standard
documents.content: Spatial Rule: Wall Art Eye-Level Standard. Room Type: all. Category: decor. Rule: The center point of single wall art pieces or gallery wall arrangements should hang at 57 to 60 inches (145-152 cm) from the finished floor (the average human standing eye-level). When hanging above a sofa or console, leave 8 to 10 inches between the top of the furniture and the bottom of the frame.

documents.title: Curtain High-and-Wide Principle
documents.content: Spatial Rule: Curtain High-and-Wide Principle. Room Type: all. Category: window_treatments. Rule: Mount curtain rods 4 to 6 inches above the window frame (or directly below the crown molding/ceiling) and extend the rod 8 to 12 inches wider than the window frame on each side. This tricks the eye into perceiving ceilings as higher and windows as larger, while letting maximum natural light enter.

documents.title: Main Circulation Pathway Clearance
documents.content: Spatial Rule: Main Circulation Pathway Clearance. Room Type: all. Category: spatial_layout. Rule: Primary traffic pathways through the room must have a minimum unobstructed walkway clearance of 30 to 36 inches (76 to 91 cm). Secondary pathways between minor furniture pieces require at least 24 inches.

documents.title: TV Viewing Distance & Height
documents.content: Spatial Rule: TV Viewing Distance & Height. Room Type: living_room. Category: entertainment. Rule: The vertical center of a wall-mounted TV screen should sit at eye level from the seated viewing position (typically 42 inches from the floor). Viewing distance should equal approximately 1.2 to 1.5 times the diagonal screen size.

documents.title: Bedside Nightstand Proportions
documents.content: Spatial Rule: Bedside Nightstand Proportions. Room Type: bedroom. Category: bedroom. Rule: Nightstand height should be within 2 inches of the top of the mattress (level or slightly higher). Nightstand width should be proportional to the bed: 20-24 inches for Queen beds, 26-32 inches for King beds.

documents.title: Dining Table Chandelier Drop
documents.content: Spatial Rule: Dining Table Chandelier Drop. Room Type: dining_room. Category: dining_room. Rule: The bottom of a dining room chandelier or pendant fixture should hang 30 to 36 inches above the surface of the dining table.

documents.title: Toddler & Child Safety Furniture Standards
documents.content: Safety & Occupant Rule: Toddler & Child Safety Furniture Standards. Occupant Type: children. Guideline: For homes with toddlers or young children: 1. Avoid sharp-cornered rectangular glass coffee tables; select round, oval, or upholstered storage ottomans; 2. All heavy bookcases, media units, and dressers must be anchored to wall studs; 3. Choose stain-resistant performance fabrics (Crypton, Revolution, Sunbrella) and washable slipcovers.

documents.title: Pet-Friendly Durability Standards
documents.content: Safety & Occupant Rule: Pet-Friendly Durability Standards. Occupant Type: pets. Guideline: For homes with dogs or cats: 1. Avoid loose loop-pile or open-weave rugs that snag claws; choose low-pile flatweave, indoor/outdoor polypropylene, or machine-washable rugs; 2. Select tight-weave microfiber, distressed leather, or high rub-count performance velvet that resists pet hair and scratching; 3. Ensure indoor plants are strictly non-toxic (safe: Calathea, Parlor Palm, Spider Plant, Money Tree; avoid: Monsteras, Lilies, Philodendrons).
